$comment: Synthetic, shaped like the error responses on Cloudflare's GraphQL Analytics errors and rate-limit pages (read 2026-11-04): HTTP 200, data null, and errors with a message, a path and extensions. The messages follow the documented patterns, except the budget one, reworded so only its extensions.code names it; the account tag is fake, and RESPONSE-BODY-TEXT marks text that must never reach the output.

errors.message: not authorized for that account RESPONSE-BODY-TEXT
cannot request data older than 2678400s RESPONSE-BODY-TEXT
Account 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef has exceeded its quota RESPONSE-BODY-TEXT
a message no page documents RESPONSE-BODY-TEXT
